sentences.en: He said that if Smith was elected, he would resign.
sentences.zh: 他说如果史密斯当选，他就会辞职。

sentences.en: The Prime Minister was obliged to resign from the Cabinet.
sentences.zh: 总理不得不从内阁辞职。

sentences.en: Women have been resigned to unjust treatment for too long.
sentences.zh: 女性太久以来一直忍受着不公正的待遇。
